_about: The agents run themselves: each agent's own cycle (routine/cycles.py). Numbers only; nothing personal. Changed in Settings or on a call (cycles.py set AGENT KEY VALUE). weekly_share and daily_share are points of the weekly usage limit; hours is when her cycles may run; a box is minutes and turns; looks_a_day is how often a day she looks at her own list inside her hours (morning, midday, evening), turning a new order into its step.

looks.name: midweek look
looks.what: Has the week's needle mover been touched yet? Look at the week's plan in your ledger, the to-do list and the calendar's ticks. If not, one short text on your line, once, in if-then shape. If yes, nothing: write one line in your ledger and end.

looks.name: evening look
looks.what: Set up the night for the team. First what the day did: a job paused, held, failed QA, or past its range (jobs.py list, the QA marks); act inside your limits and write it in your ledger. Then the planning (sprint.py list): when the usage leaves room (usageline.py), switch prepare on as yourself for the next ranked rows (sprint.py go LABEL prep on --by moneypenny), and build on for rows that are ready (go LABEL build on --by moneypenny), so the line prepares and builds them tonight. Never send a row yourself. Text your line only when the user is needed, in the batch unless it's a tripwire.
